Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of your day Siemens Energy is the only company in the world that can offer fully integrated products, solutions and services along the energy value chain. Making the world work is more complex than ever. Our mission is to help ensure that a functioning world remains the same. However, the way we ensure this will change dramatically. Within the Global DC HUB Organisation, you will be working in our Hardware operations department, supporting our business with Hardware operation demands and projects globally. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated IT Service Professional to join our dynamic team and drive of our Global DC Hardware Strategy. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IT service management, with a focus on hardware portfolio management. This role requires a strategic thinker who can align hardware initiatives with overall business goals, ensuring the organizations technology infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and efficient.How Youll Make an Impact Collaborate with key stakeholders to understand business objectives and align IT hardware strategy accordingly. Formulate and implement a comprehensive hardware roadmap, considering emerging technologies, industry trends, and organizational needs. Lead the procurement process for IT hardware, ensuring cost-effectiveness, quality, and timely delivery. Evaluate and manage relationships with hardware vendors, negotiating contracts and ensuring compliance with service level agreements. Develop and implement strategies for the full hardware lifecycle, from acquisition to retirement. Ensure efficient and responsible disposal or repurposing of outdated hardware while maximizing the value of existing assets. Collaborate with the IT support team to put in place support models that resolve hardware-related incidents and problems promptly. Implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions and downtime caused by hardware issues. Maintain comprehensive documentation of hardware configurations, procedures, and standards. Generate regular reports. What you bring We look forward to meeting you if you hold a degree in (business) computer science or business administration You bring at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, ideally in the context of IT hardware strategy. Good knowledge of ITIL framework and best practices. Strong understanding of hardware technologies, trends, and best practices. To find your way in your new international environment you bring fluent in English skills spoken and written Personally, you convince with a structured way of working, show a high degree of independence, organizational talent, teamwork and a clear communication style About the TeamThe Digital Core organization was created to streamline the lifecycle of software, data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence solutions for Siemens Energy. Within Digital Core, our Data Governance team is a center of excellence that enables the organization to discover, access and use harmonized, high quality data in service of the Siemens Energy mission. We partner with the business to support them as they build strong foundations using policy, process and technology provided by our team.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur OfficeSiemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and growing community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.Our Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
